processes.title: Apps to list
processes.description: How many apps the popup lists. Each app's helper processes count toward it.

sortBy.title: List the apps using the most

cpuWarning.title: CPU warning
cpuWarning.description: The CPU use, from 0 to 1, at which the widget takes the warning color. Set it above 1 to turn it off.

memoryWarning.title: Memory warning
memoryWarning.description: The memory use, from 0 to 1, at which the widget takes the warning color. Memory pressure and heat always warn.
